items.name: Convex hull
items.description: Build or use the convex hull of points to restrict feasible or optimal candidates.

items.name: Half-plane or support function
items.description: Use a linear inequality, separating line, or support-function query over a convex set.

items.name: Symmetry reduction
items.description: Normalize geometric configurations by translation, rotation, reflection, or other symmetries.

items.name: Lattice distance
items.description: Compute distances or movement costs over grid, lattice, tiling, or coordinate-parity geometry.

items.name: Line intersection
items.description: Construct or compare intersections of lines, segments, or pair-defined geometric constraints.

items.name: Geometry candidate enumeration
items.description: Enumerate a finite geometric candidate set induced by points, lines, intersections, tangencies, or boundaries.
